READY FOR AUDIT (operator 116) — growth-project-mobile#342 @ 728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385

Piece P1 of the payment sheet split of #334 (3 pieces: #342 -> #343 -> #344). Base `main`. T4 (max-tier rule).
Checks at this head (latest run per check, 4 checks): all green.
Land rule: Land as one (rule 11) after backend recurring #678-#680 is deployed (OR-112-13 pair with #654).

SIZE ASSESSMENT (operator 116, MODEL_ROUTING 8.2) — growth-project-mobile#342 @ 728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385
- Lines: 1685 changed (source 1600 / tests 85 / migrations 0 / docs 0; excluded 0); 9 files. Under the 3,000 hard limit.
- Seams (largest areas): `src/lib/packagePayment.ts` 1025, `src/lib/planTerms.ts` 385, `src/config/__tests__` 85, `src/config/wallets.ts` 70, `app.config.js` 43, `src/components/purchase` 41.
- Coupling: code piece with its own tests; the piece boundaries, dependency direction (no piece imports a later piece) and per-piece tests are stated in the PR body.
- Decision: KEEP. This is already one logical piece of the owner-ordered split of #334. Cutting it further would separate code from the tests that prove it, and would add a restack round to every later piece without making any line easier to audit. Fix rounds must keep it under 3,000.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#342 @ 728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/2/1

Job AUD-SOL-P12-117, agent 117. Independent T4 payment-contract and piece-boundary audit; no candidate-source edits.

### Prior findings / G09 applicability

Every P1 file is byte-identical to the original's Sol-approved `78ba9bc9a172f79fec5e7f8c3b0166acbf41dfe1`; that prior evidence applies to unchanged routing, request shape, terms arithmetic, memory-only secrets and wallet-default behavior, but **not** to compatibility with the now-changed backend error contract. All nine piece files and their consumers were independently read; this is not a copied approval. ([Prior Sol disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5972086092), [exact P1 tree](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/commit/728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385), [current recurring error contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/0e1cfde00f6293c0ddf4ee9e2c99f5321bbe2cb8/src/checkout/subscription-errors.ts))

Original B-334-3/4's native-result classification and pre-sheet amount/cadence/trial reconciliation remain present, and `mode:none` remains accepted; original C-334-3 is the P2 poll-helper delta, not a P1 change. ([Prior closure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5972086092), [current parser](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385/src/lib/packagePayment.ts#L163-L253), [current reconciliation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385/src/lib/planTerms.ts#L324-L385))

### B-342-1 — current backend uncertainty is converted into a proven no-charge claim

**File:line:** `src/lib/packagePayment.ts:512–513,556–559,728–738,783–787,853–868,880–889`. Current backend #679 deliberately uses `PAYMENT_RETRY`, `STRIPE_CHECKOUT_ERROR` and `SUBSCRIPTION_SETUP_UNAVAILABLE` for results it cannot prove unpaid; the mobile mapper ignores that distinction and says “nothing was charged,” including the unknown-500 fallback. ([Mobile mapping](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385/src/lib/packagePayment.ts#L717-L889), [backend's explicit B-679-6 uncertainty contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/0e1cfde00f6293c0ddf4ee9e2c99f5321bbe2cb8/src/checkout/subscription-errors.ts#L115-L162))

**Counterexample:** a previous native confirmation loses its response; a same-key retry cannot retrieve/retire its Stripe subscription and returns one of those coded failures, while the prior payment may have committed. The actual mapper's three coded cases plus unknown 500 each fail the truthful-outcome assertion in the independent CI lane. ([Retry/read boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/0e1cfde00f6293c0ddf4ee9e2c99f5321bbe2cb8/src/checkout/subscription-checkout.service.ts#L1134-L1161), [four executed counterexamples](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179727433/job/111369664221))

**Minimal fix rule:** do not derive no-charge from an unknown HTTP result or these codes alone; use outcome-unknown copy, a short reference and support/reconciliation next action, preserving the same attempt. Only an explicit authoritative unpaid/closed result permits a categorical no-charge statement. Verify all four probes fail before/pass after, and retain the definitive-refusal control.

### B-342-2 — finished one-time replay dispositions are unmapped

**File:line:** `src/lib/packagePayment.ts:749–889` (missing cases; default `:880–889`). Current #661's `PAYMENT_ALREADY_COMPLETE`, `PAYMENT_CHECKOUT_CLOSED` and `PAYMENT_REFUNDED_OR_IN_REVIEW` all fall to “The payment did not go through and nothing was charged,” which is false for an already-paid or refunded/review purchase and does not provide the specified disposition. ([Mobile default](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385/src/lib/packagePayment.ts#L880-L889), [current replay classifier and messages](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/6fdc35de61a26a0c9e8b3741044a3ec223dc9ab4/src/checkout/checkout.service.ts#L87-L154))

**Counterexample:** replay a finished key after a paid response was lost; the server returns `PAYMENT_ALREADY_COMPLETE`, but the mapper asserts payment failure/no charge. All three exact-contract mapper probes fail; P2 separately owns the dead-key/action continuation. ([Three executed replay cases](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179727433/job/111369664221), [P2 catch boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L710-L748))

**Minimal fix rule:** map all three codes specifically: completed → open/reconcile the existing plan; closed → actionable fresh-checkout guidance; refunded/review → status/support guidance without a fresh charge or no-charge claim. Carry machine-readable action semantics for P2, and pin each code with the actual backend envelope.

### C-342-1 — optional unknown-diagnostic allowlist hardening

**File:line:** `src/lib/packagePayment.ts:635–644,652–659,880–888`. An arbitrary unknown response `code`/`error` is copied into Sentry extras and normalized into exception/cause text; a synthetic email/free-form-note canary survives both real global event-scrub passes, although no current backend PII-emitting code path was demonstrated, so this is defense-in-depth C rather than an asserted production disclosure. ([Diagnostic construction](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385/src/lib/packagePayment.ts#L625-L659), [executed scrub-boundary canary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179727433/job/111369664221))

**Minimal fix rule:** allowlist bounded backend/native machine labels and use a constant unknown label; never incorporate unknown strings into error messages, causes or extras. Verify the canary disappears while known codes and references remain.

### Exact-head execution / landing boundary

Independent test-only commit `cf91d1b` has an empty candidate runtime/config/dependency delta: **8 probe failures / 7 passing controls**, including six wallet controls and the definitive-refusal control; the nonexistent requested `clientPaymentsApi.test.ts` selector did not execute and is not evidence. Exact-head ordinary CI passes **449 suites / 6,283 tests**, and Typecheck/lint/test plus both required CodeQL analyses are successful. ([Independent run](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179727433/job/111369664221), [ordinary full execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37152688718/job/111289624734), [exact-head CodeQL analyses](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37152688697))

P1 adds no hook/screen imports from later pieces and stays under the size gate; land the payment stack as one only after the backend recurring chain is approved/deployed, retaining the original native-card-update composition condition in the final P3 tree. No native-provider/device or production acceptance is claimed. ([P1 split/readiness assessment](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/342#issuecomment-5975774150), [original composition condition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5972086092))

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#342 @ 728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/1/3

Lens: Claude Opus 5.5, agent 117, AUD-OPUS-P12-117. Independent audit of split piece S1 of #334 at its exact head (base main, BEHIND main 7fdb629a; the PR files are unaffected). Paired backend contract read at its current heads: #678 2174eb7c, #679 0e1cfde00f6293c0ddf4ee9e2c99f5321bbe2cb8, #680 d1c62ee100e4abd72c21295c32f8b32e450981da (`subscription-errors.ts`, `subscription-checkout.service.ts` and `checkout.service.ts` are byte-identical between #679 and #680).

Evidence reuse (G09): the last Opus APPROVE on this code is #334 @ 0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a (https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5964822138). Byte-identical to that head and reused: `.env.example`, `app.config.js`, `config/expected-env.json`, `src/api/clientPaymentsApi.ts`, `src/components/purchase/usePaymentSheetAppearance.ts`, `src/config/wallets.ts`, `src/config/__tests__/wallets.test.ts`. Changed since then and audited in full: `src/lib/packagePayment.ts` (+150/-21 vs 0629d506, FIX ROUND 3/4), `src/lib/planTerms.ts` (+86). All 9 files were read in full for piece-boundary safety. Not reused: any Sol evidence.

Piece boundary: compiles alone (Typecheck/lint/test green at this head, https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37152688718/job/111289624734); nothing imports S2/S3; `packagePayment.ts` has no importer at S1 (inert); wallets default off and the Stripe config plugin is added only when a merchant id or Google Pay flag is set. Two piece-boundary notes are C-342-2 and C-342-3.

## B-342-1 — `src/lib/packagePayment.ts:512-513, 556-559, 783-787, 853-869` tells an unconfirmed subscription outcome as "nothing was charged"

`describeBackendFailure` maps three subscription-intent codes to copy that claims no charge:
- `PAYMENT_RETRY` -> `retrySameAttempt`: "The last attempt did not finish and nothing was charged. ... You will not be charged twice."
- `STRIPE_CHECKOUT_ERROR` -> `stripeUnavailable`: "The payment service did not answer, so nothing was charged."
- `SUBSCRIPTION_SETUP_UNAVAILABLE` -> `setupUnavailable`: "The trial could not be set up right now and nothing was charged." (also says "trial" for a paid, non-trial plan)

The paired backend now sends exactly these codes when the outcome is NOT confirmed (B-679-6 / B-679-7, backend #679 @ 0e1cfde0):
- `src/checkout/subscription-errors.ts:102-115` `inProgress(true)` -> PAYMENT_RETRY, "its result is not confirmed yet. Open Your plan to check whether it started before you try again."
- `subscription-checkout.service.ts:766-777` (`mintSubscription`): "paid or in flight although the attempt closed meanwhile ... never a no-charge answer" -> `throw inProgress(true)` (logged `billing.subscription_paid_after_close`). Reachable from this app: an earlier sheet on the same attempt was confirmed with an unclear answer, the key is kept, and the client taps Start again with the same key.
- `subscription-errors.ts:121-137` `stripeFailure(err)` (noCharge defaults to false) -> STRIPE_CHECKOUT_ERROR "this step did not finish"; thrown at `subscription-checkout.service.ts:936` (`replayAttempt`, the retrieve of an already bound, possibly paid subscription fails).
- `subscription-errors.ts:151-158` `setupUnavailable(false)` -> "closing it is not confirmed yet"; thrown at `subscription-checkout.service.ts:834` (`finishBound`) in payment mode as well as setup mode.
The backend separates proven no-charge from unknown only in its message text; no machine field. So the mobile copy must not assume no charge for these codes on `subscription_intent`.

Probe (red at this head, 4 failed / 4): https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37180147690 (branch `audit/AUD-OPUS-P12-117/342-probe`, spec `src/lib/__tests__/audOpusP12117.probe342.test.ts`). Received, for example: "The last attempt did not finish and nothing was charged. Start again to continue where it stopped. You will not be charged twice." for the backend's "result is not confirmed yet" PAYMENT_RETRY body. The same defect reproduces through the #343 hook (run 37180210458, see the #343 verdict); it is fixed here.

Minimal fix rule: for step `subscription_intent`, PAYMENT_RETRY, STRIPE_CHECKOUT_ERROR and SUBSCRIPTION_SETUP_UNAVAILABLE never claim no charge. The copy says the result is not confirmed yet, tells the client to check Your plans / Membership before starting again, and keeps the support email and reference (a Check again that reads the plan is optional). SETUP_UNAVAILABLE copy does not say "trial" unless the plan has a trial. The one-time `payment_intent` PAYMENT_RETRY may keep its no-charge copy (`checkout.service.ts:602-608`: there it means the winner failed and freed the key). One test per code, failing before the fix. Alternative (operator decision): the backend adds a machine field when no charge is proven and mobile keys on it; default is the mobile copy change, which needs no backend round.

## C-342-1 — `src/lib/planTerms.ts:83-88` a combo with a $0 recurring part is routed as a renewing plan

`isCombo` only checks `recurringAmount !== null`; the header (`planTerms.ts:10-12`) says the rule mirrors backend `isRecurringPackage()` exactly, which requires `recurring_amount_cents > 0` (`checkout.service.ts:93-104`: "A combo's recurring part of $0 renews nothing: it is a one-time sale"). A row `{billing_type:'one_time', amount_cents:20000, recurring_amount_cents:0, recurring_interval:'month'}` becomes a renewing $0.00-a-month plan (`renewing: true`, `amountCents: 0`): the request goes to subscription-intent, the backend answers ONE_TIME_REQUIRES_PAYMENT_INTENT, mobile shows termsChanged and reloads into the same row, so the plan can never be bought from the app. Backend package validation (recurring minimum, `packages.service.ts:755-762` at #680 head, also on backend main) blocks new rows like this, so only a legacy row can hit it: C. Probe: same run 37180147690, case "a one-time package whose recurring part is $0 ..." (Expected false, Received true). Fix rule: `recurringAmount !== null && recurringAmount > 0`.

## C-342-2 — `src/api/clientPaymentsApi.ts:347-349` (piece boundary) S1 alone is not fully inert

S1 un-nulls `trial_days`. On main, `ClientPackagesScreen.tsx:447-448` and its CTA already render "{n}-day free trial" / "Start free trial" from that field while still buying through POST /v1/checkout/sessions, which starts no trial. Harmless only because the stack lands as one (S3 replaces that screen), mobile main does not build or update on push, and backend main has no `trial_days` column yet (it arrives with the paired backend stack). Fix rule: no build from a main that has S1 without S3; or keep the land-as-one rule recorded in the merge plan.

## C-342-3 — piece boundary: S1's money logic has no test in S1

`packagePayment.ts` (1,025 lines) and `planTerms.ts` (385 lines) are tested only by suites in S2 (`PackageSelectionSheet.payment.test.tsx`) and S3 (`PackageSelectionSheet.recur3.test.tsx`, `.subscription.test.tsx`). S1's own CI proves compile and the existing importers only. Fix rule: any fix round on S1 runs the S2 and S3 sheet suites against the S1+S2 code in the CI lane and cites the run.

## What holds (audited at this head)
- Routing: renewing (recurring, or one-time with a recurring part) -> subscription-intent; one-time paid -> payment-intent; $0 one-time -> claim-free. Interval guard rejects unknown cadences (null, never a guess).
- `subscription-intent` request body: `package_id`, `idempotency_key` (UUID), `expected_amount_cents`, `expected_one_time_cents`, `share_token` only in its 21-character form; matches `CreateSubscriptionIntentDto` (#679 controller lines 50-78, forbidNonWhitelisted).
- Response shape: `seti_`/`pi_` prefix cross-checked against `mode`; `mode: 'none'` needs `purchase_id`; matches `resultFromRow` (`subscription-checkout.service.ts:1231-1262`).
- `checkout_state` (`packagePayment.ts:273-290`): only `awaiting_payment` / `awaiting_card` count as proof of no charge.
- B-334-1 (prior Opus finding) remains closed: SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED and PACKAGE_ALREADY_INCLUDED are mapped to their own copy.
- Sentry (`reportPackagePaymentFailure`, `packagePayment.ts:625-649`) gets cause, step, status, code, reference and the Stripe error code / decline code / type only; no client secret, ephemeral key or body text.
- Copy rules: no first person, no exclamation marks, no generic error text in any new string.

CI at this head: Typecheck/lint/test, Analyze (js-ts, actions) and CodeQL green. Probe branch is deleted when this job ends.

## Money list self-check
- Webhook order and redelivery: the app consumes no webhooks and never infers paid from event order; it reads entitlement / purchases / plan after the sheet, and PAYMENT_ALREADY_COMPLETE only triggers an idempotent entitlement refresh.
- Concurrency (two workers, lock order): server-side locks are the backend's; on the client one in-flight guard and one key per package + sale kind (#343) make every replay hit the same backend reservation.
- Terminal states (refunded, disputed, canceled, deleted account): PAYMENT_REFUNDED_OR_IN_REVIEW shows status + support and never opens a new charge; a canceled sheet makes no claim; account change is fenced on #343.
- List pagination and completeness: no Stripe list in S1; the purchase / plan reads on #343 fail closed to "outcome unknown", never to "nothing was charged".
- Currency: amounts are the backend's minor units (`amount_cents`) in the backend's currency, formatted only; no conversion on the device.
- Copy truth: "nothing was charged" now appears only where the backend or the missing route proves it (definite refusals, one-time PAYMENT_RETRY, renewingUnavailable); every unconfirmed answer says so and offers Open your plan plus support with a reference.

Follow-up Cs (not fixed, freeze): Opus C-342-1 (planTerms.ts:83-88 `isCombo` needs `recurringAmount > 0`), Opus C-342-2 (land #342-#344 as one for main's old ClientPackagesScreen), Opus C-342-3 (now partly covered by the new S1 test file). Details in ops/reports/B-SHEET-118.md.

## B-342-1 — partly repaired: a lost HTTP response still becomes proof of no charge

**File:line:** `src/lib/packagePayment.ts:789–790` and offline copy `:456–457`. The repaired coded/unknown-HTTP branches are neutral, but any error without `response.status` immediately says “This phone is offline, so the payment did not start and nothing was charged”; a transport timeout is neither an offline diagnosis nor proof about the prior same-key attempt. ([Exact mapper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/56f281ad3aa977882c962a6591d3594899cdd5a1/src/lib/packagePayment.ts#L789-L792), [actual HTTP timeout/interceptor](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/56f281ad3aa977882c962a6591d3594899cdd5a1/src/services/api.ts#L98-L100))

**Executed counterexample:** the native one-time confirmation loses its answer, canonical purchases remain unreadable/not visible, and the same-key payment-intent retry times out without an HTTP response; the real hook replaces outcome-unknown copy with the categorical no-charge sentence. Both payment-intent/subscription-intent mapper probes also fail, while the missing-production-route and historical coded controls pass. ([Real-hook failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220350184/job/111489249671), [two mapper failures / 36 passing controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220350807/job/111489251167))

**Minimal fix rule:** uncoded transport failures must preserve outcome uncertainty, the outstanding key, a short reference, and support/plan-reconciliation guidance; only a genuinely proven pre-send refusal may claim no charge. Replay the no-response tests through the real hook, not only coded HTTP envelopes.

## B-342-3 — newly wired consent formatting misstates a permitted JPY charge by 100×

**File:line:** new `src/lib/planTerms.ts:150–151,155–161,215–221,224–226`, delegating to inherited `src/utils/currency.ts:13–19`. A package with `amount_cents:4900,currency:'jpy'` is accepted by the adapter and shown as 49 yen in the plan price/CTA, but the one-time backend forwards `amount:4900,currency:'jpy'` unchanged to Stripe, whose minor-unit contract charges 4900 yen; the backend permits three-letter currencies rather than enforcing USD-only. ([New formatting boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/56f281ad3aa977882c962a6591d3594899cdd5a1/src/lib/planTerms.ts#L150-L161), [inherited unconditional division](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/56f281ad3aa977882c962a6591d3594899cdd5a1/src/utils/currency.ts#L8-L21), [backend accepted currency](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/76aa84b8350ea56e8dac65757efe6ebac6579569/src/packages/packages.service.ts#L898-L903), [actual charge parameters](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/f80f0088c98cd078cffa5dd217a8fdc84ad631b2/src/checkout/checkout.service.ts#L708-L712), [Stripe presentment minor units](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies))

**Executed counterexample:** the actual adapter plus `money` returns numeric **49**, expected **4900**, for JPY; the USD control passes. The lane also includes an exploratory KWD-formatting failure, which is not relied on as proof of supported Stripe presentment. ([Exact-runtime currency probe: 2 failures / 1 control pass](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220824000/job/111490624818))

**Minimal fix rule:** format supported presentment minor units using the currency's applicable exponent, with no FX/settlement conversion; preserve exact integer request amounts and require terms/CTA/first-charge tests for USD plus a supported zero-decimal currency. The helper itself is inherited, but this new money-consent consumer is unsafe with its unconditional cent assumption, so this is B, not an unrelated utility cleanup.
